# daily-research

> An autonomous research engine run by macOS launchd every morning at 05:00. Each research line runs Claude Code (`claude -p`) twice: call 1 (Opus) picks one outside development as a question and ends in one of four content states — article, brief, quiet (nothing new) or hold — recorded in a run receipt; call 2 (fresh context, fail-open) revises the note for first-contact readability and re-fetches every claim to check it against its source. Notes go to an Obsidian vault with a free-form body and two fixed tail sections (機会メモ for dated opportunities, ソース). Two kinds of line: repo lines (`mode = "repo"`) run inside one research repository and rotate, `[general] lines_per_day` a morning; ecosystem lines (`mode = "ecosystem"`) have no repository, run from their own `state/<line>/` directory and observe outside change directly, usually every morning (`daily = true`). Both calls run with `--safe-mode`, a fixed built-in tool set and a deny-list boundary. Bash orchestration with prompt files; JSON/TOML parsing in stdlib python3.

Status: active, maintained by hand in this repository and run every morning by the author. Each fact has one canonical source, listed below; this file points to them instead of copying values.

## Core documentation

- [README](README.md): human-facing overview, setup and configuration (English)
- [README (日本語)](README.ja.md): the same in Japanese
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): where each fact lives, and the conventions that cannot be read off the code
- [ADR index](docs/adr/README.md): every design decision with its reasons, dated

## Architecture

- [ADR-0019](docs/adr/0019-wide-line-safe-mode-static-state.md): the current shape — a broad ecosystem line plus one rotating repo line a day, `--safe-mode` and `--tools` on both calls, static briefs, no per-run bookkeeping by the model, past questions appended by code, recent repo activity in the prompt
- [ADR-0018](docs/adr/0018-ecosystem-mode-and-daily-jev-line.md): `mode = "ecosystem"` — lines with no target repository
- [ADR-0017](docs/adr/0017-three-line-window-content-states-and-verification-pass.md): rotation window, four content states with a receipt-driven gate, question-level dedup, call 2 as verification + clarity
- [ADR-0014](docs/adr/0014-trend-explanation-report.md): the objective — one outside development explained, with what it means for the repo
- [ADR-0010](docs/adr/0010-rotation-and-two-tier-eval.md): rotation and in-loop evaluation; no after-the-fact LLM judge
- [ADR-0008](docs/adr/0008-per-repo-in-context-research.md): per-repo in-context research; why the concept-graph pipeline was retired
- [ADR-0006](docs/adr/0006-self-improvement-loop-human-consumer.md): report gate, deterministic lint, metrics.jsonl and /dr-review

## Source of truth

- [Orchestrator](scripts/daily-research.sh): the run itself — rotation, both calls with their flags, tool sets, deny rules and write paths (`WRITE_PATHS`), the report gate, lint, metrics
- [Parsing module](scripts/lib/dr_pipeline.py): stdlib-only JSON/TOML; receipt, past-topics, billing and lint contracts as constants
- [Repo research protocol](prompts/repo-research-protocol.md): call 1 for repo lines
- [Ecosystem research protocol](prompts/ecosystem-research-protocol.md): call 1 for ecosystem lines; shares the receipt, evidence-file and content-state contract with the repo protocol
- [Verification protocol](prompts/verification-protocol.md): call 2
- [Report template](templates/report-template.md): writing rules, frontmatter and the two fixed tail sections
- [config.example.toml](config.example.toml): every setting with its default
- [Verify gate](.claude/verify.sh): lint, bats and pytest in one entry point

## Operations

- [RUNBOOK](docs/RUNBOOK.md): launchd, monitoring, log messages, troubleshooting, billing caps
- [Contributor guide](docs/CONTRIB.md): test seams (`DR_DATE` / `DR_ONLY_TRACK` / `DR_FORCE_TRACK`) and how to add a line
- [Skill manifest](SKILL.md): install the repo as a Claude Code skill

## Optional

- [graph.jsonld](graph.jsonld): frozen archive of the retired concept-cluster graph; receives no more increments ([schema](docs/graph-schema.md))
- [metrics.example.jsonl](metrics.example.jsonl): shape of one `metrics.jsonl` record
- [shimo4228 (hub)](https://github.com/shimo4228/shimo4228): the author's hub — the research repositories the lines are grounded in, their DOIs, and the tools
- [llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org/): the llms.txt standard this file follows
